hints.content:
The table of values for the first plant shows that for each decrease of $\blue{\text{Time}}$ by $\blue 5$ days, $\pink{\text{Height}}$ decreases by $\pink 2$ centimeters. We can extend the table according to this rate to find the value of $\pink{\text{Height}}$ when $\blue{\text{Time}}$ was $\blue 0$ days:

Time | Height
-:|-:
$0$ | $30$
$-5\uparrow$ | $-2\uparrow$
$5$ | $32$
$-5\uparrow$ | $-2\uparrow$
$10$ | $34$
$-5\uparrow$ | $-2\uparrow$
$15$ | $36$
$-5\uparrow$ | $-2\uparrow$
$20$ | $38$
This means that the first plant was $\pink{30}$ centimeters tall when Nara got it.

The height of the second plant when Nara got it is represented by the $y$-intercept of the line, which is $(0,30)$. This means that the second plant was $\pink{30}$ centimeters tall when Nara got it.

**Since $\pink{30}=\pink{30}$, both plants were equally tall when Nara got them.**

The rate at which the first plant grew is the ratio of the corresponding differences in $\pink{\text{Height}}$ and $\blue{\text{Time}}$:

$\dfrac{\Delta \pink{\text{Height}}}{\Delta \blue{\text{Time}}}=\dfrac{-2}{-5}=\green{0.4}$

This means that the first plant grew at a rate of $\green{0.4}$ centimeters per day.

The rate at which the second plant grew is represented by the slope of the line. In addition to $(0,30)$, the line passes through the point $(10,38)$. We can find its slope by taking the ratio of the corresponding differences in the $y$-values and the $x$-values of our two points:

$\qquad\dfrac{38-30}{10-0}=\green{0.8}$

This means that the second plant grew at a rate of $\green{0.8}$ centimeters per day.

**Since $\green{0.4}<\green{0.8}$, the second plant grew faster.**

Let's sum it up:

- Both plants were equally tall when Nara got them.

- The second plant grew faster.

question.content:
Nara got two new plants for her apartment. Each plant grew at a constant rate.

The height (in centimeters) of the first plant as a function of time (in days since Nara got it) is given by the following table of values:

$\text{Time}$ (days) | $\text{Height}$ (centimeters)
:-: | :-:
$10$ | $34$
$15$ | $36$
$20$ | $38$

The graph of the height (in centimeters) of the second plant as a function of time (in days since Nara got it) is shown below.

**Which plant was taller when Nara got the plants?**

**Which plant grew faster?**

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x-axis, labeled Time (days), runs from 0 to 24 and is scaled by 1. The y-axis, labeled Height (centimeters), runs from 0 to 50 and is scaled by 2.  A graph of a line intersects the points (0, 30), (5, 34) and (10, 38).

choices.content: They both grew at the same rate
